notes.id: Total biaya masuk gelombang I Rp11.450.000, gelombang II Rp13.200.000 (paket buku, seragam, dokumen, kegiatan 1 tahun, SPP 1 bulan). Artikel blog menyebut tahun ajaran 2026, tetapi angkanya tampak lama (2020–2023). Konfirmasi ke sekolah.
notes.en: Total entry wave I Rp11,450,000, wave II Rp13,200,000 (books, uniforms, documents, 1 year of activities, 1 month's tuition). The blog post says academic year 2026, but the figures look old (2020–2023). Confirm with the school.
